process_area.title: Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management

fields.Participants: DC Ops, WMS, Inventory Control, Quality

workflows.name: Centralized Kit Build (DC) Work Order & Assembly Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates kit-build work order per build plan" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "updates kit and component inventory" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-506 (ensure controlled execution — Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management (PA-92.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Build-error risk**: Wrong components/quantities in finished kit; mitigated by WMS-directed picking and QC (W3075)
System Touchpoints: - WMS kit-build work order (links to VS-04); component consumption; kit SKU receipt

steps.activity: DC Ops/WMS generates kit-build work order per build plan (W3069); allocates and picks components per BOM (W3066)
DC assembly staff build kits per work order; package, label, and apply kit SKU barcode; stage finished kits to saleable inventory
WMS/Inventory Control confirms component consumption and finished-kit receipt; updates kit and component inventory; closes work order

fields.Participants: Store Mgr, Sales Associates, Stock Associates
fields.Trigger: Display bundle or store-assembled kit requirement
fields.Volume: 200 stores; display bundles and light assembly

workflows.name: Store-Level Kit Build, Display Assembly & Light Value-Add

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates assembled display against planogram" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-506 (ensure controlled execution — Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management (PA-92.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Display-cost risk**: Display assembly consumes saleable components without tracking; mitigated by ERP component consumption
System Touchpoints: - Store task system (links to VS-63); planogram (links to VS-55); component consumption at store

steps.activity: Store Mgr/Visual Merchandising receive display-assembly task (e.g., assembled grill display, furniture set, contractor combo display) via VS-55/VS-63
Sales/Stock Associates assemble display or store-assembled kit per instructions; apply price/label; position for sale; consume components in ERP
Store Mgr validates assembled display against planogram (links to VS-55); manages display maintenance and disassembly for component recovery (W3078)

workflows.name: Component Picking, Kit Quality Check & Build Verification

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scan-confirm each component and quantity to prevent substitution errors" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "inspects finished kit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "log build defects" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-76 (ensure kit build & component inventory integrity.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Defect-escape risk**: Defective kits reach customer; mitigated by scan-confirm and QC sampling
System Touchpoints: - WMS-directed picking; kit QC checklist; defect logging (links to VS-31)

steps.activity: DC Ops/Store Staff pick components per WMS-directed BOM; scan-confirm each component and quantity to prevent substitution errors
Quality inspects finished kit: correct components/quantities, packaging integrity, labeling, and certification marks (per W447 for regulated)
Quality/Inventory Control log build defects; route rejects to rework or disposition; feed defect rate to vendor/process improvement

fields.Participants: Inventory Control, DC Ops, Quality, IT

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "create kit lot/serial inheriting earliest component expiry where relevant" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "genealogy for traceability supporting recalls" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor kit expiry" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-76 (ensure kit build & component inventory integrity.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Traceability gap**: Kit genealogy lost hampers recall scope; mitigated by lot/serial capture at build
System Touchpoints: - Lot/serial genealogy; expiry management (links to W1005); recall traceability (links to VS-89)

steps.activity: Inventory Control/DC Ops capture component lot/serial at build; create kit lot/serial inheriting earliest component expiry where relevant
IT/Inventory Control maintain kit-to-component lot/serial genealogy for traceability supporting recalls (links to VS-89) and warranty (links to VS-53)
Quality/Inventory Control monitor kit expiry (chemical/paint kits); enforce FEFO and expiry-based disposition (links to W1005)

fields.Participants: Inventory Control, DC Ops, Store Ops, LP
fields.Volume: Kit and component inventory across DCs/stores

workflows.name: Kit Inventory Reconciliation, Variance & Shrinkage Control

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counts kit and component stock" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document root cause" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalates to VS-23" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-76 (ensure kit build & component inventory integrity.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Variance risk**: Kit/component mismatch distorts inventory and availability; mitigated by cycle counting and genealogy
System Touchpoints: - Cycle counting (links to VS-05/W6); inventory adjustment approval; LP analytics (links to VS-23)

steps.activity: Inventory Control cycle counts kit and component stock; reconciles system vs. physical; investigates variances (missing kit, missing component, built-but-unreceipted)
DC/Store Ops correct variances: post adjustments with approval, rebuild/re-tear to reconcile, and document root cause
LP investigates shrinkage patterns (component theft, kit pilferage); escalates to VS-23; tracks kit shrink vs. target (<1.5%)

fields.Participants: Inventory Control, DC Ops, Store Ops, Quality
fields.Trigger: Kit discontinuation, damage, or display teardown

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generate tear-down order against kit SKU" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "inspects returned components for resaleability" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles value recovery vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-506 (ensure controlled execution — Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management (PA-92.2).)
- operational: QC inspection and careful disassembly
Pain Points / Risks: - **Value-loss risk**: Components damaged in tear-down or written off; mitigated by QC inspection and careful disassembly
System Touchpoints: - Tear-down work order; component return-to-stock; quality disposition (links to W3021)

steps.activity: DC Ops/Store Ops generate tear-down order against kit SKU; disassemble; return saleable components to stock per BOM
Quality inspects returned components for resaleability (damage, packaging, expiry); routes non-saleable to disposition (links to W3021)
Inventory Control posts kit-to-component inventory conversion; updates cost; reconciles value recovery vs. kit write-down (links to W3072)

fields.Participants: Vendor Mgmt, Supply Chain, Quality, AP

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate component supply to co-manufacturer" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "inspects finished kits from co-manufacturer" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-506 (ensure controlled execution — Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management (PA-92.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Custody risk**: Component loss/theft at co-manufacturer; mitigated by WIP visibility and reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Vendor portal (links to VS-03); consignment/WIP inventory (links to VS-45); co-manufacturing charge (links to W7)

steps.activity: Vendor Mgmt/Supply Chain contract 3PL/co-manufacturer for kit assembly; define BOM, quality standard, SLA, and component custody
Supply Chain/Vendor Mgmt coordinate component supply to co-manufacturer (consignment or sale); manage in-transit and WIP visibility
Quality inspects finished kits from co-manufacturer; AP reconciles co-manufacturing charges and component usage; scorecard vendor (links to VS-67)

fields.Participants: DC Ops, Supply Chain, HR/Labor Planning, Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-forecast of "forecasts build labor hours from build plan and standard times" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors build labor cost vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-506 (ensure controlled execution — Kit Assembly, Build Execution & Inventory Management (PA-92.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-bottleneck risk**: Build labor competes with pick/ship labor at peak; mitigated by sequencing and labor balancing
System Touchpoints: - Labor planning (links to W34/VS-19); build schedule; labor cost analytics (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: DC Ops forecasts build labor hours from build plan and standard times; balances against DC pick/ship labor capacity (links to W34/PA-19.3)
Supply Chain/DC Ops sequence builds to smooth workload and avoid peak pick contention; prioritize high-margin/high-velocity kits
HR/Labor Planning adjusts labor to build demand (seasonal ramp, overtime, temps); Finance monitors build labor cost vs. value
